statements.t: “Achieving substantial enrollment in the FORTIFI-HN01 pivotal trial reflects strong execution by our team and growing recognition among investigators that HPV-negative disease requires a targeted approach grounded in its distinct biology.
The company expects to have results from this study by the time of a potential U.S. approval in 1L R/M HPV-negative HNSCC.
Based on its current operating and development plans, the company expects that its existing cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities will fund operations into the first half of 2029.
